notes.notes:

notes.title: First look at Netflix's Narcos as a video game
notes.notes:
Earlier in the year, British publisher Curve Digital announced it was working on a video game version of hit Netflix show Narcos.

If you haven't seen it, Narcos is a gritty Colombian cartel drama starring the guy who's head got popped on Game of Thrones. It's good watching, if you have the stomach for it.

Today we got our first glimpse at the game Curve is cooking up by way of its development studio partner Kuju.

notes.title: One Year Later: Major Content Update
notes.notes:
[i]Narcosis[/i] debuted one year ago today, so as a 'thank you' to all of you who've taken this journey with us — and those still to come — we've updated the Steam edition of the game with some very exciting extras...

First up: "[i]Raptures of the Deep: A Journey into Narcosis[/i]," 15 ambient tracks inspired by our deep-sea survival story, including the eponymous closing theme from celebrated composer [b]Akira Yamaoka[/b] ([i]Silent Hill[/i] series). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/cf1b9e5a4a8823885b5d30800f1acbdf3b7467f1.png[/img]

Also included: "[i]Hell or Highwater: Surviving Oceanova[/i]," survivor Kip Mattas' official, first-person account of the catastrophe that captivated the world's attention on the Feb 21, 2021. Previously available only via Amazon, it's now included with the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/657c64cef34558d21a647afcfd9c2dfbcae7038e.png[/img]

Finally, we've also included the entire accompanying radio interview with Mr. Mattas on [i]Open Air[/i], now downloadable for your on-the-go listening pleasure. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/2fda7d4f1d112053be0d8be114e96ab2a346969c.png[/img] 

For those of you interested in seeing how deep the game's narrative threads go, we hope you'll enjoy these 'supplementary materials,' which — in conjunction with the game, itself — comprise the "complete [i]Narcosis[/i] experience."

Thanks again, and remember: if you've enjoyed your time with our debut title, we hope you'll take a moment to spread the word, or leave a review. [i]Narcosis[/i] is a small fish in a mighty big sea, and your support makes a difference. 

[b]Honor Code, Inc.[/b]

notes.title: (Difficulty) Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear divers...

Since Narcosis launched (nearly a year ago!) we've received quite a bit of praise, and not a few criticisms. In particular, there's one key level midway through the game that's a little less... explicit in its instructions, as to where to go, and how to get there. Those of you who've played it may remember the eighth level - fittingly called "[i]FOLLOW PROCEDURE[/i]" - in which the Survivor finds himself (even more) lost and directionless, after an... unexpected encounter. 

Having read your feedback, and watched dozens of streams, we got the gang back together to try and make this particular section just a little bit easier. [i]Narcosis[/i] is - at its dark heart - a survivor's story, and we hate to think that some of you might opt not to reach the (bitter? sweet?) conclusion, on account of some poor game balancing.  

If all that is too cryptic, a transcript of the change log is pasted below. Nothing too spoiler-y, but it's redacted, just in case...

Whether its your first time playing, or if you're going through again to try and uncover some of the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/366870/discussions/0/135514402721509373/] many, many secrets[/url] we've stashed deep beneath the sea, we hope you'll enjoy the journey, and share your thoughts with us.

Finally, the one-year anniversary of the game's release is approaching. With that in mind, we've got a few more exciting announcements incoming... So watch this space!

[b]Change Log:[/b] 
[spoiler]
+ Changed start point
+ Changed blinking light depending of that new position (it disappears in the desert... That's normal)
+ Changed some fishes' paths
+ Added new trigger for spider in the desert
+ Added some path to go to the other side
+ Added anemones glowing in order to lure player to the other side
+ Changed a bit the slide of the volcanoes to better trap player
+ Made easier to climb the new way from the volcano to the exit[/spoiler]

notes.title: Narcosis is 33% off, and now with Oculus Touch support!
notes.notes:
[h1]Want to cool down from the summer heat?[/h1]

Now's the chance, enjoy the cold depths at [b]33% off[/b] during the Steam summer sales.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/1e6e309da1c256080f6b7ed46770961c4ce02b5f.png[/img]

[h1]Occulus Touch Support[/h1]

Adding to our support to VR platforms, we want to make sure that you can play on these with the associated input methods. 
Now, as we already discussed with some of you in the forums, we won't be able to support full motion controls, as that would require a significant amount of rework.

That said, you can now enjoy Narcosis using Oculus Touch controllers, with the following (for now) fixed control scheme : 
[list]
[*]Stick (Left Touch)  : Movement
[*]Stick (Right Touch) : Rotation
[*]A (Right Touch) : Use/Menu validation
[*]B (Right Touch) : Cancel
[*]Y (Left Touch) : Recenter VR sensor
[*]Trigger (Left Touch) : Knife
[*]Trigger (Right Touch) : Flares
[*]Grip (Any Touch) : Thruster
[*]Menu key (L touch) : Menu
[/list]

Vive controllers support is coming up as well, just need a bit more work. 

[b]Changelist [v1.1.3.18535][/b]
[list]
[*] Oculus Touch Support (see above)
[*] Fixed the achievements "Signs of Life" and "Memento Mori" that didn't trigger for some people. If you're among them, they should unlock once you launch the game with this new update. (Thanks to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198108973018]Altermind[/url] for helping out with this)
[*] Balanced a bit oxygen supplies in some levels.
[/list]

Meanwhile, [url=https://twitter.com/kadincunagin]@kadincunagin[/url] shared this chibi-fied Lego version of the game's signature ADS suits ...

notes.title: Vox Machina
notes.notes:
Slowly but steadily, the reviews are rolling out, and by and large we're pleased with the reception: it seems that many reviewers, streamers and — most importantly — players recognize and appreciate our effort to try and do something a little bit different.

One aspect that's received near-universal praise is the actor giving voice to the survivor's thoughts and fears. If you've seen one of the trailers, you've heard that captivating blend of weariness, fear and resolve. And if you've played [i]Narcosis[/i], you know there's more to this narration than is immediately apparent. This isn't just a survivor, but a human being.

Three years ago, when we set out to cast the role, the very first person we talked to, turned out to be absolutely perfect: former podcaster (Weekend Confirmed), indie game enthusiast, and all-around gentleman [b][url=https://twitter.com/JeffMattas] Jeff Mattas[/url][/b].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/cbb55d80654c4d77cb7f6837205c6b170b843cb5.jpg[/img]

Jeff's performance has been called out by media from around the world, describing it as "top-notch," "on-point," and "outstanding" — and we couldn't agree more. Since coming on board, he's been working tirelessly with the team, patiently indulging a ridiculous number of rewrites and requests to get [b]Every. Word. Right.[/b] And as it turns out, he's also one hell of a writer — he truly brought his character to life, both at the keyboard and behind the mic.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/2fda7d4f1d112053be0d8be114e96ab2a346969c.png[/img]

Thank you, Jeff, and all the best in moving on to bigger, better roles — many talented people gave their best to bring Narcosis to life, but you're the one to give it a voice.

notes.title: Narcosis: an international affair
notes.notes:
Well we (finally) dropped a new [url=https://youtu.be/tFMEF5CCxt8/][b]trailer[/b][/url], and the response has been pretty positive, overall. Somewhat surprising: we've seen [b]a lot[/b] of queries/comments as to whether it's Robert Downy, Jr., or Tom Hanks who's doing the VO (spoiler: it's neither). 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/fcb91ef947d5354c817b77049685426398b36494.png[/img]

In the last few days, we've been fortunate to have been picked up by gaming media from around the world. This is encouraging, as we set out from the start to bring the game - and the story it tells - to as wide of an audience as possible. Working with talented translators to bring the game to 11 languages was a bit of a nightmare, logistically... but it's important, and we hope it proves worth the effort.

notes.title: Trailer. Launch details. Narcosis surfaces March 28...
notes.notes:
Honor Code, Inc. is pleased to announce that its debut effort, [i]Narcosis[/i], launches on Steam, Oculus and Xbox One on March 28, 2017. [i]Narcosis[/i] has garnered critical acclaim for its unique setting, compelling narrative, striking visuals and subtle but effective usage of virtual reality. An all-new trailer demonstrates some of the surreal sights, sounds and situations encountered in the abyss.
https://youtu.be/tFMEF5CCxt8
[i]Survival, horror at the sunless depths of the Pacific Ocean: Stranded on the seafloor with low light and few tools, an industrial diver takes desperate steps to surface before his dwindling oxygen — and sanity — give out.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/a3220c7e15b15d6c5d04f27cd17dde46a14034de.png[/img]
First conceived as a student project, this first person survival story unfolds from inside a “walking coffin” —  a half-ton, high-tech deep-sea dive suit —  following an industrial catastrophe. Influenced and inspired by a growing appetite for unconventional horror and narrative-driven games, [i]Narcosis[/i] is rooted in reality, but steeped in the surreal.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/d536a531a7be30edcd6a9f86e17886c68491aead.jpg[/img]
Hi All,

We had a great time showing [url=store.steampowered.com/app/366870/]Narcosis[/url] at Unite ‘16 this past week, rubbing shoulders with smart, inspiring folks and getting to check out a great variety of cool games #madewithunity. We’d like to mention a few of our favorites, in no particular order...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/d2fa578e65bde48f96125fd17551e0830c531a47.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.borealysgames.com/mages-of-mystralia/]Mages of Mystralia[/url] is Borealys Games’ beautiful,upcoming action-RPG. It features  a very cool, deep player-managed spellcrafting system that we can’t wait to play more of.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/bb25cb1c404a52ddf4b8c872e58878a10f6602d0.jpg[/img]
Sunburned Games’ [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/464830/]The Great Whale Road[/url] is a turn-based, story-driven RPG set in the Dark Ages. It’s reminiscent of Stoic’s [i]Banner Saga[/i] games, in the best way possible.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/122b2eaa09ffc90bb66ac602c25b338584e3934b.jpg[/img]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/453310/]Blackwood Crossing[/url] ships in February courtesy of PaperSeven LTD; it’s a compelling first-person adventure yarn about a couple of orphans on an ordinary train ride that magically evolves into a story of “life, love and loss.” We’ll be waiting at the station when it arrives.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/0d90f61f412820fa26ebd8e01c3eab449849a576.jpg[/img]
[url=store.steampowered.com/app/402710/]Osiris: New Dawn[/url]  is an incredibly ambitious (and awesome-looking) sci-fi survival action-sim from Fenix Fire Entertainment. Though it won’t be as vast as the procedurally generated universe in [i]No Man’s Sky[/i], the current and planned gameplay features — including co-op multiplayer, spacewalking and building settlements — already appear to be far more robust.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/fae347908d792eae5a0c4ccf4b2da1f46540538e.jpg[/img]
[url=store.steampowered.com/app/378610/]Valley[/url] from Blue Isle Studios came out in August; it’s a cool first-person adventure-platformer where the player explores and uncovers the mysteries of a remote location in the Rocky Mountains. If you liked the traversal aspects of A Story About My Uncle (Gone North Games), Valley ought to be right up your alley.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/ff903c6a3858064c293023e05a7b6c5b1f84d8d8.jpg[/img]
Ragtag Studios have been supporters of Narcosis for quite a while. We’ve been looking forward to their debut title, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/251650/]Ray’s The Dead[/url], for quite some time, and it’s looking better than ever. You’ll play as Ray, both before and after he becomes a zombie. ‘Recruit’ some more undead friends and command your own zombie horde. Release is still TBD, but we’ll be hungry for brains when it arrives.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/7997b4f2b7e67c0e74a2818aad8db5472515db04.jpg[/img]
[url=http://www.sombr.com/invisigun-heroes/]Invisigun Heroes[/url] is Sombr Studios’ first game, and features some of the best multiplayer fun we’ve had in quite a while. Single-screen stealth battle arenas make for some fast-paced, chaotic matches, and to top it off, all players are invisible unless firing or using their unique special ability. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/8dbb1f222934195a9723d831e36481d0a432b2b5.jpg[/img]
We met some of the Ecuadorian team Freaky Creations at E3 a few years ago, so it was cool to catch up in L.A. again. [url=http://freakycreations.net/#to-leave]To Leave[/url] is a surreal action adventure that tells the story of a young man named Harm, who uses is magical flying door to escape the ravenous megalopolis of Candice - which is trying to destroy him. It’s on PS4, and well worth a gander.

As for [i]Narcosis[/i], we’re nearing the finish line and can’t wait for folks to play the finished work. We’ve locked down a release date, and will be ‘content-complete’ in just a few weeks… Stay tuned for more updated and announcements soon.

As always, you can follow us on [url=facebook.com/NarcosisGame/]Facebook[/url], [url=twitter.com/NarcosisGame/]Twitter[/url], and [url=instagram.com/honorcodeinc/]Instagram[/url] for more updates.

Cheers!

The Honor Code Team

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/89db0bfb4abf5707761dd3a1615abef26359b9d3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Narcosis Update - Other Indies Worth a Look
notes.notes:
Development of Narcosis is humming along, and we'll be showing it off again at [url=https://unite.unity.com/2016/los-angeles]Unite '16[/url] next week. In the meantime, all of us at Honor Code wanted to take a moment to give a shout out to some fellow indies you should be checking out.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/44459e2a4fdbe0000b036e700dcbed1bdb99bc51.jpg[/img]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/368430/]Through the Woods[/url] just released on Steam, and it's a non-traditional horror game (which we love, for obvious reasons). It's a "third-person Norse horror adventure set in a forest on the western shores of Norway that tells the story of a mother and her missing son." They pretty much had us at "Norse horror."

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/a940b7f88c46b76521d6e8a2b7e53182207edf13.jpg[/img]

If you prefer the sub-nautical over the supernatural, you might want to check out [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/378700/]Neptune Flux[/url], a story-driven sci-fi game set beneath the sea, launching on November 15. One of the cool things about working independently is that you can reach out to other teams about swapping assets, and not have to worry about getting sued. If you end up checking it out, keep an eye out for a "blink and you'll miss it" reference to the Oceanova initiative (which plays a key role in Narcosis' narrative).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/873c6888a7a678e5a5358c6961efd9d700b00a6c.jpg[/img]

Finally, it appears we've been beaten to the "best breathless simulator" punch. We met the guys from Orthogonal Games (who also created The Novelist) a few weeks back at an Intel event, and were immediately impressed by their first-person arctic survival thriller [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/327560/]Near Death[/url]. In the creators' words, it's "not a survival game, but instead a game about survival" — which is so clever, we kinda wish we'd written it first. It's available on Steam right now.

That's it for now. Don't forget to follow us via [url=facebook.com/NarcosisGame]Facebook[/url] and [url=twitter.com/narcosisgame]Twitter[/url], where we try and post (a little) more regularly.

Cheers!

-Honor Code Team

notes.title: Dispatches from the Depths: 10/19
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

we're still crunching away, but wanted to share a few more updates with you...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/a4ebd7a16f5aef2cb0f178d8af668896c1d52a0a.jpg[/img]

[b]RECENT EVENTS:[/b]
While [i]Narcosis[/i] wasn't officially demo'd at Oculus Connect 3, the organizers were kind enough to invite us to come and check out all the cool stuff they've got lined up. For us, one of the more exciting announcements was the Asynchronous Spacewarp feature, which enables VR games to run on a broader spectrum of hardware. We've been testing it out, and the results have been promising (although, of course, VR's [b]not[/b] needed to experience [i]Narcosis[/i]...) 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/92391a61a74134805f172c63be9bb80dfb9590a0.jpg[/img]

A few of us managed to sneak off to demo the game at [url=http://www.indiecade.com/2016/games]Indiecade[/url] alongside seven other "VR Selects." The crowd was cool, the reception was warm, and we even managed a few moments to check out our peers' games and experiences, including [i][url=http://www.daydreamblue.com]Daydream Blue[/url][/i], [i][url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/1106538986077576]Floor Plan[/url][/i], [i][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/451080]Giant Cop[/url][/i], [i][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/443790]Irrational Exuberance[/url][/i], [i][url=http://www.visiontrick.com/blog/mare]Mare[/url][/i], and [i][url=http://superhypercube.com]SUPERHYPERCUBE[/url][/i].

In a few weeks we'll be back in L.A. at the [url=https://unite.unity.com/2016/los-angeles]Unity '16 Conference[/url]... And finally, for our friends in Europe: we're still waiting on the official go ahead to announce the details, but looking forward to sharing details on our next public showing there... soon.

[b]OTHER UPDATES:[/b]
    [*]In addition to the big ol' backlog of bugs and polish items we're working through, we're still steadily layering lots of new SFX, animations and sound effects into the game. Each of these brings nice new layers of — wait for it — [i]depth[/i] to the whole "stranded at the bottom of the sea" vibe.
    [*]Localization is in full-swing: (text) translations are nearly complete for French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian and Japanese, and we recently added Brazilian Portuguese, Polish and Turkish into the mix. [i]Narcosis[/i] is a largely ambient, solitary experience, but narrative's been a key part of the equation from the start — we're looking forward to sharing it with as many players as we can, when the game goes live.
    [*]We're finally finding the time to start working on some "out of game" features, including achievements, trading cards and badges, and...
    [*]...debating whether (and how) to release a "Collector's Edition" of the game — if you have opinions on special packages, we'd love to hear them... 
[/list]

Don't forget to follow us via [url=https://www.facebook.com/NarcosisGame/]Facebook[/url] and/or [url=https://twitter.com/narcosisgame]Twitter[/url] for more — and more frequent — updates!

— [b]Honor Code[/b]

notes.title: Dispatches from the Depths: 9/28
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9759705/c7ea4f4abeab33951129501de3a8f657d8e0bacf.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

to put it mildly, we haven't been as good as we should, about keeping in touch. But we're in the final stretches: the game's being refined rapidly, day by day, and we're looking forward to sharing more — and more frequent — updates with you (Including a trailer) in the weeks to come...

Lately, we've been asked a lot about a launch date. To be honest, we're reluctant to make more promises, as they're easily broken ([b]Exhibit A:[/b] our trailer, which mentions a "2014 release"). 

But rest assured development continues 24/7 (literally: some of the team's based in the SF Bay Area, with the rest spread across  several cities in France), and we'll have news to share on this front soon. Most of us have been working on [i]Narcosis[/i] for over three years — so we're determined to bring you something special.

If you're looking for even more frequent updates — or feel like helping us get the word out — we hope you'll join us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/NarcosisGame/]Facebook[/url] and/or [url=https://twitter.com/narcosisgame]Twitter[/url].

Some recent developments: 
[list]
[*]Our French team just wrapped up a three week workshop in Angoulême. We only see one another a few times a year, so it was a great chance to get together, and a lot accomplished. Pics [url=https://www.facebook.com/NarcosisGame/photos/?tab=album&album_id=1218964074820346]here[/url], if you're curious.
[*]At the same time, we wrapped our second and final VO recording session — below's a photo of voice actor [url=https://twitter.com/JeffMattas]Jeff Mattas[/url], and a mystery guest...
[*]In addition to numerous visual and UX changes, here are some cool new features recently added to the game:
[*][b]VFX: [/b]ink and blood, storms and particles...
